title: Shelf recording
description_html:
Film the assigned grocery aisle at a store in Nashua, NH 03060. You record the shelf in the Hetal app while you are already shopping. You do not buy anything, deliver anything, or talk to store staff.

Pay: $10 per visit. Hetal reviews the video in 1 to 3 business days. Approved pay goes to your bank account.

This is a short, temporary visit, about 10 minutes in the store. Finish it any day while this listing is open. It is not a recurring shift. This listing is open through December 15, 2026.

  • Download the Hetal app and reserve this visit.
  • Walk the assigned aisle slowly and film the shelf from top to bottom.
  • Keep the phone steady. A clear video is what gets approved.
  • Upload the video on Wi-Fi.

No experience is required. No special education is required. You need a smartphone and location services turned on while you film, so Hetal can confirm you are at the store.
